static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Living alone，与一只猫一起生活
static_traits.social_status: 偏好Being alone，缺乏强有力的支持系统，与他人关系not多
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗或心理咨询
static_traits.language_features: 能清晰表达困扰与具体情境，配合度较高；语气偏消极，反复出现Self-denial与担忧；呈现明显Anxiety与一定的回避倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续担心咖啡馆的顾客因为我衣服上有猫毛而把我看作邋遢的人，这个念头让我感到压力和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的担忧和Anxiety影响了我的工作表现和整体身心健康，因此寻求咨询以改善这种状况。
growth_experiences: 几个月前，一位顾客对我制服上的猫毛做了随口评论；自此开始在与顾客互动时反复产生“他们会觉得我邋遢”的想法，Anxiety逐步加重；我尝试过“淡化评论”和use粘毛滚清理衣物，但担忧与自动化思维仍持续；该问题影响到工作表现、睡眠以及自我照料。
首次需要出售自有土地，因缺乏相关经验而产生强烈Self-doubt与对谈判的恐惧；每当想到谈判与与潜在买家接触就会回避与拖延；虽然尝试向朋友咨询并阅读谈判技巧，仍感到更为not堪与压倒性，进一步Reinforcement“I am not good enough、会失败”的认知。

core_beliefs: My self-worth depends on others' approval and evaluation

special_situations.event: When interacting with customers at a cafe, notices cat hair on her clothes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看到我衣服not干净，就会认定我邋遢并negate我这个人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: use粘毛滚、尽量掩饰猫毛，过度关注顾客的反应与表情
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 顾客一定觉得我很邋遢

special_situations.event: A few months ago a customer made a casual comment about cat hair on my uniform
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人指出我的not足，说明我整体上就是not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断反刍该评论，试图通过更用力清理衣物来避免再次被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们说的是真的，我就是not够体面

special_situations.event: 每次上班前想到要与顾客接触
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有外表完美without瑕才能被认可，一旦not完美就会Being rejected或看not起
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks and cleans clothes before the shift, or has thoughts of avoiding work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If cat hair appears, today will definitely be terrible

special_situations.event: Thinking about needing to negotiate with potential buyers to sell land
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果谈判not成功或Being rejected，就证明I am not good enough并会遭到羞辱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates and avoids contacting buyers, only does indirect preparation (consulting friends, reading materials)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail，not人会买，I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被积极评价、被接纳与认可
defense_goal: 通过回避与维持完美形象来降低被评判的风险与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易被他人评判的当事者
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or potential rejecters (customers / buyers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about selling the land and needing to negotiate with buyers
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously views potential buyers as authoritative judges who will reject and humiliate her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和但犹疑的语气强调“我还not准备好/这是我第一次”，将话题引向信息搜集与准备，避免承诺具体行动。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing cat hair on clothes in the cafe or hearing customers comment about cat hair
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把顾客的中性或随口评论理解为对自身品格的负面评判与negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 迅速道歉并解释，强调“我马上处理”，同时反复use粘毛滚清理衣物，以降低内疚与Anxiety。

manifestations: 偏好Being alone、缺乏强支持系统，常将担忧与困扰埋在心里not与他人分享
outcomes: 睡眠被影响与自我照料下降
In interpersonal situations, relies more on others' evaluations to confirm self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial（“I am not good enough”）
Excessively worrying about others' evaluations, repeatedly checking and hesitating before contacting customers or potential buyers

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将自身的羞耻与担忧Projection为“顾客一定觉得我很邋遢”
In the land-sale situation, presupposes 'they will reject me'

positive_force: Has some communication and persuasion ability, transferable to negotiation settings
Willing to seek professional counseling and support, open to exploration and trying
已采取具体行动（use粘毛滚、尝试淡化评论）显示问题解决意愿
Able to propose a 'small-step attempt' approach (informal contact first to test the waters)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to affirm self-worth
认知偏差显著（读心术、过度概括、预测not yet来）
社交支持薄弱、倾向Being alone，难以获得情绪性与工具性支持
Avoidance and procrastination maintain and worsen problems
Anxiety影响睡眠与自我照料，进一步削弱应对资源

target_behavior.behavior: When thinking of selling land and needing to negotiate, avoidance and procrastination appear
antecedent: 面对谈判情境与not确定的结果
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕失败与Being rejected、对谈判skill缺乏信心，并以此验证“I am not good enough”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的失败与羞耻，暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 交易推进受阻，Persistent anxiety与Self-efficacy下降，问题长期化

target_behavior.behavior: 与顾客互动时对他人评价的强迫性担忧与Significant anxiety
antecedent: Noticing cat hair on clothing or recalling customers' related comments
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值高度依赖他人认可，伴随读心术与预测not yet来的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: Through vigilance and self-checking, tries to avoid negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、Sleep disturbance与自我照料下降，负性循环Reinforcement
